title: Microbiome Assay 96WP
author: Saul Moore
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8kbhusn

steps.title: Prepare N2 Worms
steps.instruction: Prepare L4-stage N2 worms for synchronization.

substeps.instruction: Pick 10 L4-stage N2 worms onto each of 10 OP50-seeded 90mm petri plates using an eyebrow hairpick 4 days prior to bleaching.

steps.title: Bleach Synchronization and Arrest
steps.instruction: Synchronize worms and maintain arrested L1s.

substeps.instruction: Perform bleach synchronization of C. elegans.
Keep the tube with bleached N2s on a rotator in a 20°C incubator until refeed (do not exceed 5 days).

steps.title: Refeed Arrested L1s
steps.instruction: Refeed the arrested L1 worms and store them.

substeps.instruction: Refeed arrested L1s (e.g., on Monday at 3pm if tracking is planned for the following Thursday) following the bleach synchronization protocol.
Store the refed L1 plates in a 20°C incubator.

steps.title: Prepare Imaging Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare low peptone NGM plates in 96-well plates (96WP).

substeps.instruction: At least 2 days prior to tracking, make approximately 250ml of low peptone NGM.
Dispense 150ul of agar into each well of the 96WP using the integraviafill.
Let the agar dry and store plates at 4°C (lid side down) until use (up to one week).

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Cultures
steps.instruction: Prepare and standardize the bacterial strain of interest.

substeps.instruction: Streak the bacterial strain on an appropriate LB plate at least a week prior to tracking (store at 4°C for up to 1 month).
Grow an overnight culture of the bacterial strain 3 days prior to tracking.
Measure the optical density of the cultures at 600nm wavelength.
Dilute the bacterial cultures with LB broth to obtain an OD600 = 1.
Keep the diluted bacterial culture at 4°C until seeding.

steps.title: Configure OpenTrons Robot
steps.instruction: Set up the Python script and hardware for automated seeding.

substeps.instruction: Design a Python script defining labware (1 flat-bottom 96wp source plate, 2 Whatman 96wp destination plates, 2 pipette tip racks 10ul) and pipette parameters.
Verify the script using 'opentrons_simulate'.
Connect OpenTrons to a computer via USB and open the app (ensure computer Wi-Fi is OFF).
Connect to robot ID 'OT2P20180526A07' via the 'ROBOT' sidebar tab.
Select the script from the 'PROTOCOL' sidebar tab.
Calibrate the robot in the 'CALIBRATE' tab using dummy labware and adjust the P10 8-channel multi-pipette arm positioning.
Replace dummy labware with actual experiment labware.

steps.title: Seed Bacterial Plates
steps.instruction: Automate the seeding of bacteria into the 96WP plates.

substeps.instruction: Run the script to seed 2 separate 96WP Whatman plates from 2 columns of a single source plate: Column A1-H1 maps to the first destination plate (12 replicates), and Column A2-H2 maps to the second destination plate (12 replicates).
Ensure rows A and E contain OP50 control, and all other rows contain test bacteria.
Allow plates to dry under a hood for approximately 1 hour.

steps.title: Prepare Worm Suspension
steps.instruction: Wash and concentrate the refed L1 worms.

substeps.instruction: Two days post-refeeding, wash worms off maintenance plates using several milliliters of M9 and collect in a 15ml falcon tube; fill to 15ml with M9.
Centrifuge at 1500rpm for 2 minutes, remove supernatant with a pasteur pipette, and add another 15ml of M9.
Repeat the wash step 2 more times.
After the final wash, remove supernatant leaving 10ml of worm solution in the tube.
Add 10ul of 1:10 dilution of Tween to the solution.

steps.title: Standardize Worm Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine and adjust the worm density.

substeps.instruction: Take 3-4 aliquots of 5ul of the worm solution onto a maintenance plate and count the worms in each droplet.
Calculate the average number of worms per 5ul and dilute with M9 if necessary to reach the desired concentration.

steps.title: Dispense Worms and Incubate
steps.instruction: Seed the worms onto the prepared bacterial plates.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 5ul of the worm solution into each well of the seeded 96WP.
Store the plates at 20°C until the next day.

steps.title: Track Worm Behavior
steps.instruction: Perform imaging and tracking using the Hydra rig.

substeps.instruction: On the morning of tracking, remove plates from the 20°C incubator and keep under a hood for 1 hour to dry M9 and remove condensation.
Place plates under the Hydra rig and record for 15 minutes.
Wait 1 hour, then record the plates for another 15 minutes.
Discard plates in biological waste bins.
